description: Compare Total Landed Cost across multiple destination countries for the same product. Useful for finding the cheapest import route or comparing duty rates between countries. Returns a side-by-side comparison of costs. Include material for accurate classification.

destinationCountries.description: List of destination countries to compare (ISO 2-letter codes, e.g. ['US', 'GB', 'DE', 'JP'])

material.description: Primary material for accurate classification. Example: 'cotton', 'steel'

name: compare_countries
